top_claim: The bounded local harness detects the five declared seeded money-conservation defects; production financial correctness is not established.

claims.statement: The local harness detects the seeded unbalanced-ledger observation.
assumptions: Input is a complete bounded observation at the declared tenant, transaction, and currency grain.
limitations: No PostgreSQL or representative ledger execution was performed.

claims.statement: The local harness detects the seeded allocation leakage observation.
assumptions: The source amount and all allocations are present in one bounded observation.
limitations: No real allocation pipeline or holdout workload was executed.

claims.statement: The local harness detects the seeded cumulative over-refund observation.
assumptions: The charged amount and all refunds are authoritative and reconciled inputs.
limitations: Provider, bank, dispute, and unknown callback outcomes were NOT_RUN.

claims.statement: The local harness detects two durable effects for one scoped idempotency key.
assumptions: All durable effects for the scoped key are present in the observation.
limitations: Concurrency schedule exploration and durable-store execution were NOT_RUN.

claims.statement: The local harness detects a seeded mismatch between invoice detail, subtotal, tax, and total.
assumptions: All invoice lines and tax values use one exact currency and six-decimal-or-less representation.
limitations: Tax engines, invoicing providers, PostgreSQL, and representative invoices were NOT_RUN.

residual_risks.description: No untouched independently verified holdout corpus exists.
No authorized production-derived representative workload exists.
Provider, PostgreSQL, concurrency, and production runtime behavior are NOT_RUN.
Both local oracles share the engineering owner and lack independent approval.

monitoring_obligations: Block release until independent holdout and representative evidence exists.
Block unknown provider or bank outcomes from retry, close, refund, or publication.
Re-run digest-bound local replay after any harness, test, corpus, or contract change.
